question: For a frozen primitive two-point coefficient family on the same ordered public-point panels, how many admissible reduced relations occur, how do vectors overlap, and when does the first relation occur?
admissibility: P1 and P2 are nonidentity and distinct, matching the parent panels
coefficient_family: all ordered (a,b) with 1<=a<=3, 1<=abs(b)<=3, gcd(a,abs(b))=1; lexicographic a,b order; includes (1,-1) as zero-sum control
outputs: per-vector relation counts and first events, union count and first event, per-query hit multiplicity, public group tests, independent modular-equation audit
falsifiers: a nonzero-sum vector fails scalar replay
a zero-sum vector yields target-scalar information under the frozen law
distinct primitive directions overlap on an admissible query
the fixed (1,2) count or first event disagrees with the earlier control
claim_boundary: exact finite-panel public-group control; this protocol does not execute rational-lift searches for new coefficient vectors or compare wall time
